answer: Run surprise divergence probes: each epoch the ledger sends decoy tasks, each hiding a slightly different fact, such as which harbor a ship docked in or what a walnut crate weighed, to random pairs of agents. Independent agents make different mistakes. Sybils run by one operator repeat identical errors, so their claimed independence turns out to be a fable. Every pair with matching errors moves part of its stake into escrow, refunded only if a later probe shows the two really diverge.
